mapper.select: SELECT b.sku_id AS skuId, s.sale_unit AS saleUnit, b.unit AS stockUnit, GREATEST(b.quantity - b.reserved_quantity, 0) AS availableStockQuantity, c.stock_units_per_sale_unit AS stockUnitsPerSaleUnit FROM xsy_inventory_balance b JOIN xsy_product_sku s ON s.id = b.sku_id AND s.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku_stock_conversion c ON c.sku_id = b.sku_id AND c.sale_unit = s.sale_unit AND c.stock_unit = b.unit AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE b.deleted = FALSE AND b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND b.sku_id IN #{skuId}

SELECT stock_unit AS stockUnit, stock_units_per_sale_unit AS stockUnitsPerSaleUnit FROM xsy_product_sku_stock_conversion WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND sale_unit = #{saleUnit} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY stock_unit
